response.overview: Super Bowl XIV, played on January 20, 1980, at the Rose Bowl in Pasadena, California, saw the Pittsburgh Steelers defeat the Los Angeles Rams 31-19, claiming their fourth Super Bowl title in six years and solidifying their place as one of the NFL’s most dominant dynasties. This victory marked the end of an era for Pittsburgh, as they became the first team in NFL history to win four Super Bowls, a feat that wouldn’t be matched for over a decade.
response.tagline: Pittsburgh Steelers vs. Los Angeles Rams
response.title: Super Bowl XIV
